disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain professional practice consistent with all initial and subsequent requirements for certification under the chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: "Unprofessional conduct" as defined in Section 58-1-501 and as may be further defined by rule includes failing to maintain a level of professional practice consistent with all initial and subsequent requirements by which certification is achieved or maintained under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional or unlawful conduct as defined by statute or rule under this title.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has engaged in unprofessional conduct, as defined by statute or rule under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401 - Grounds for denial of license -- Disciplinary proceedings -- Time limitations -- Sanctions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Determination of mental incompetence by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or mental or physical condition posing a threat to public health.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is unable to practice the occupation or profession with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition, when the condition demonstrates a threat or potential threat to the public health, safety, or welfare.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401 - Grounds for denial of license -- Disciplinary proceedings -- Time limitations -- Sanctions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a passing score on a licensure examination, applying for or obtaining a license through fraud, forgery, or intentional deception.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining a passing score on a licensure examination, applying for or obtaining a license, or otherwise dealing with the division or a licensing board through the use of fraud, forgery, or intentional deception, misrepresentation, misstatement, or omission
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501 - Unlawful and unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or engaging in, representing oneself to be practicing, or attempting to practice any profession requiring licensure without being licensed or exempted.

disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501 - Unlawful and unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or attempting to practice a profession through gross incompetence, gross negligence, or a pattern of incompetency or negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501 - Unlawful and unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct resulting in a conviction or guilty plea for a crime bearing a substantial relationship to the ability to safely or competently practice the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in conduct that results in conviction, a plea of nolo contendere, or a plea of guilty or nolo contendere that is held in abeyance pending the successful completion of probation with respect to a crime that, when considered with the functions and duties of the profession for which the license was issued or is to be issued, bears a substantial relationship to the licensee's or applicant's ability to safely or competently practice the profession
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501 - Unlawful and unprofessional conduct.

definition_quote.value: Dietetics means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of food for the development, management, and provision of dietary services for individuals and groups for meeting their health care needs.

methods_authorized.quote: "Dietetics" includes: (a) the evaluation of a person's dietary status; (b) the advising and education of persons on dietary needs; and (c) the evaluation of needs, implementation of systems to support needs, and maintenance of appropriate standards of quality in food and dietary service for individuals, groups, or patients in licensed institutional facilities or in private office settings.
